{{Top|leg}}
'''Echo Three''' was the callsign given to a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in [[Echo Flight]], a [[N-X Police Cruiser/Legends|N-X Police Cruisers]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]].

During the first phase of the [[Battle at TFP-9]] the ship took some damage from [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]]. When the adversaries received reinforcements, Till ordered Three and others, to keep concentrating against the old fighters.<ref name="The Starfighter Trap">{{GamerCite|1|The Starfighter Trap}}</ref>
